en:
//　例えば、自己を中心とする空間を立方体と想定し、
  Imagine space as a cube with myself at the center.

//　これを五単位分割し、
  Divide this cube into five vertical and five horizontal tiers.

...as well as every diagonal line of five spaces...

//　あらゆる対角線が、

<YELLOW>Assign the values so that every vertical, horizontal, and diagonal line of five spaces adds up to the same total value.</YELLOW>

  <YELLOW>First click the value you wish to place. Then click the space on the grid where you wish to place it.</YELLOW>

//◆※難易度低下ＯＮのみ
  <YELLOW>Hint: the target value is 315.</YELLOW>
